name: ema-mcp
description: Keyless Cloudflare Worker MCP exposing the EMA EPAR medicines dataset (European Public Assessment Reports) to the evidentia plugin: EU medicine authorisation status, CHMP opinion/decision dates, orphan/conditional/accelerated flags, ATC, INN, MAH, indication and EPAR URLs. Baked corpus (build_corpus.mjs) from the authless EMA XLSX; closes evidentia's EMA/CHMP-EPAR gap.
